manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Place the gum bottle on the red card.

Task description: The target is the gum bottle with a white cap and green-and-white body on the table; the red card is to its right. Use the right gripper to move the bottle onto the card.

Success criteria: The gum bottle is picked up and placed on the red card, touching and supported by it. After the gripper is released, it remains on the card.

## Execution tips

- Try to grip the middle of the bottle body below the white cap, letting both pads make full contact. Make the opening slightly wider than that section and avoid the protruding cap rim and base near the table.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite bottle sides rather than merely overlapping in the view. If sliding or tilting appears during a small test lift, restore tabletop support before adjusting the grasp.
- During transport, keep both the bottle base and fingertips clear of the table, leaving enough height to clear the card edge and avoiding dragging the bottle or catching the card.
- Keep the bottle upright during placement where possible, with its base inside the card and away from the edge. Release only after confirming support under the base to reduce tipping or moving the card.

The gripper is fully open, and the bottle remains upright on the red card. I will raise the gripper slowly, confirm the bottle has separated from it, then end the episode.
